verdict.rationale: Increase's docs say you can create virtual and physical cards via the API as soon as you sign up, including unlimited virtual cards. Spend control comes from real-time authorization decisions sent by webhook to your servers, with 3DS supported through real-time decisions. missing for 10: any evidence of digital wallet support (Apple Pay/Google Pay provisioning), documented declarative spend limits or merchant-category controls beyond webhook decisioning, explicit documentation of how cards link to an Account, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the card features.
